estilo: Documentary photo, soft natural daylight, Brazilian home garden, realistic colors, sharp focus, no text, no logos

fotos.cena: Close-up of a man's hands dropping knobbly beetroot seeds into a glass of water to soak overnight, on a wooden garden table
Close-up of a man's hands sowing beetroot seeds about 1 cm deep in a shallow furrow of a vegetable bed; the small mascot figurine stands on the soil at the end of the furrow
Close-up of a man's hands using small scissors to snip the extra seedlings from a cluster of young beetroot seedlings, leaving only one
Crowded row of beetroot plants with small undersized roots pressed against each other in a vegetable bed
Chioggia beetroot cut in half showing pink and white concentric rings inside, next to whole beets with leaves
Rainbow Swiss chard with red, yellow and orange stalks growing among flowers in a garden bed; the small mascot figurine sits on the edging stone of the bed
Bunch of white asparagus spears beside a bunch of green asparagus on a rustic wooden table
Tray of beet microgreens with small green leaves and bright red stems and veins on a sunny windowsill
